items.statement: Working capital cycle expected to remain healthy or improve given strong demand and rising prices
items.quote: Looks like the markets are staying strong and the demand is very steady and prices are going high. In a situation like that if history has to be considered we have always seen that the working capital cycles remain very healthy.

items.statement: Receivables are high due to rapid CapEx deployment and a one-to-one-and-a-half-month lead time before machines generate revenue; expected to stabilize as top line grows.
items.quote: It is expected to stabilize. It is that this financial year has been like a V-shaped demand cycle for us. So, the whole point is that since we are adding so many machines, like, our projections were just, as I told you, on INR 400-crore CapEx side, even though one and a half years is left, we are already done with more than half of the CapEx cycle. So because of that, the receivables are going up.

items.statement: DSO improved to 70 days at end of Q3 FY26
items.quote: From a financial perspective, our DSO continues to improve and now stands at 70 days at the end of Q3 FY26.

items.statement: Debtor days vary by export market; Europe 30-60 days, Latin America and US up to 90 days; domestic branded sales mostly cash with minimal credit
items.quote: So if it is Europe, then the credit can be up to 30 to 60 days and even against shipment, but in case of like Latin American countries or America, you need to give them credit up to maybe 90 days also.

items.statement: Merger with Ricardo Elevators will involve equity in low single digits, 2-3% dilution for L.T. Elevator shareholders, locked for 3-4 years with 25-30% unlocking annually.
items.quote: indicatively, what we have agreed in-principle is, equity in the low single digit in L.T. Elevator, so we are talking between 2-3% dilution for L.T. Elevator shareholders.

items.statement: Equity issued to Ricardo promoters locked for 3-4 years, unlocking proportionally 25-30% per year.
items.quote: this equity also sort of is locked for a period of three to four years and then it gets unlocked proportionally like every year, maybe 25-30% gets unlocked, but it is locked equity just so that the team is with us for the near term and they continue to grow this together.

items.statement: Company plans preferential issue once markets improve to fund capacity expansion for 1,500-2,000 elevators in FY28.
items.quote: Yes, we would probably look to do a preferential once the markets are slightly better because right now the way the markets are it would be difficult to raise the money we want to.

items.statement: Share of group company business is constantly increasing while co-lending and BC partner share is reducing as a strategic shift to improve capital effectiveness and yields.
items.quote: However, our focus has drastically shifted towards the self-sourcing of Muthoot Capital Services owned business and through the businesses done by our group companies. So the share of group company business is constantly increasing, while the share of co-lending and BC partners is constantly reducing.

items.statement: MCSL owned portfolio grew 42% YoY to INR2,712 crores while co-lending portfolio degrew 26% YoY to INR685 crores.
items.quote: Last year, at the same time, MCSL portfolio was INR1,911 crores. Now in this quarter, we are closing at INR2,712 crores, marking a growth of 42 percentage in the MCSL portfolio only. On the co-lending side, we have reached at a height of INR939 crores as a co-lending closing portfolio. Now that has been brought down to INR685 crores, marking a degrowth of 26 percentage in the co-lending portfolio

items.statement: Cash and cash equivalents of INR13 crores; company remains net debt-free
items.quote: Cash generation remains strong, and our balance sheet continues to be healthy with cash and cash equivalents of INR13 crores.

items.statement: Preferential round of Rs 94.3 crore fully received; 25% warrant money also received
items.quote: out of the entire Rs. 94.3 crores, international expansion is Rs. 10 crores, product development is Rs. 49.33 crores, sales and marketing is Rs. 12 crores, and general corporate purpose is Rs. 23 crores

items.statement: Management declines to comment on future equity dilution or fundraise plans
items.quote: Currently, that is something that we will not be able to disclose. We will not be able to comment at this stage because it is unpublished, price sensitive information.

items.statement: Senior management ESOPs on four-year vesting linked to revenue and bottom line
items.quote: Everybody who joins Veefin is on ESOPs, and ESOPs of senior management are always linked with the revenues and the bottom line of the company. So, the reward structure for senior management is always aligned with how well the company will do in the long-term. And all are on four year vesting periods in terms of ESOPs.

items.statement: Agreement to increase stake in EpikIndifi expected around 2027
items.quote: So, we have the agreement for that is somewhere in 2027. So, it is not right now. It will come up later.

items.statement: Auditor qualified non-compliance with Ind AS 19; actuarial valuation done annually, not quarterly; no major financial impact expected
items.quote: So for the Ind AS 19, for the employee benefit, the actuarial valuation, we are getting it done on an annual basis instead of a quarterly basis. And all that needs to be provided will be provided in the annual accounts.

items.statement: Company is virtually debt-free on a net basis with net debt of INR0.1 crores, reflecting strong liquidity and cash flow
items.quote: Importantly, the company is now virtually debt-free on a net basis with a net debt of just INR0.1 crores.

items.statement: Management stated the company is currently debt-free and holds around INR 300 crores of cash.
items.quote: And as far as ROE is concerned, I think if you have to sce the cash adjusted equity, so that is much higher because we have around INR 300 crores of cash, which is lying with us and cash adjusted ROE is around 15
